page_title: LEV 2-0 SEV | Levante v Sevilla 23/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Jose Sanchez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' 2 - 0 Goal! Kervin Arriaga tees up Ivan Romero (Levante) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the left side of the goal. 2:0.
90+3' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! That's a free kick to Sevilla.
90+3' Oso (Sevilla) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+3' Sevilla force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+1' Ivan Romero (Levante) has tested the patience of referee Jose Sanchez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+1' Victor Garcia (Levante) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Sevilla hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
88' Having seen unsporting behavior, Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) is the recipient.
87' Sevilla fail to score from a corner as Mathew Ryan (Levante) leaps to collect the ball.
87' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
85' Luis Castro has decided to substitute Carlos Espi and he is replaced by Karl Etta Eyong (Levante).
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch so that Ruben Vargas can be given a rest.
82' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Sevilla! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Jose Sanchez and both teams have no complaints.
81' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
80' Sevilla enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
77' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
77' Manu Sanchez (Levante) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
75' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Odysseas Vlachodimos pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
75' Oso (Sevilla) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Sanchez blows for a foul. Levante are awarded the free kick.
73' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
72' Here is a change. Nemanja Gudelj is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Peque (Sevilla).
71' The manager makes a subsitution with Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) coming on for Isaac Romero.
70' Some patient build-up play from Levante as they look to unlock the defence.
68' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sevilla.
67' Carlos Espi (Levante) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
65' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Juanlu Sanchez is replaced by Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla).
65' Manuel Bueno Sebastian goes off the pitch and Djibril Sow (Sevilla) comes on.
64' One of the players from Sevilla times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
63' Substitution. Kervin Arriaga (Levante) on for Jon Ander Olasagasti.
63' Luis Castro has decided to make a change. Carlos Alvarez (Levante) replaces Ugo Raghouber.
60' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
59' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Ugo Raghouber (Levante) for his blatant foul.
58' Victor Garcia (Levante) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
57' Levante seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
56' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
54' Oso (Sevilla) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
53' A cross from Oso (Sevilla) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
52' Akor Adams (Sevilla) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
51' Levante are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
49' What a big chance! Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
48' The Levante players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+8' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+6' Carlos Espi (Levante) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
45+4' Great teamplay by Sevilla as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
45+3' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
45+2' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle and it's Victor Garcia (Levante) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Sevilla win a free kick.
45+1' Matias Moreno (Levante) tries to find Ivan Romero, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
44' The Sevilla players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. It's a throw-in for Levante.
42' Luis Castro is forced to make a change. Kareem Tunde is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Victor Garcia (Levante).
40' Kareem Tunde (Levante) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

40' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Jon Ander Olasagasti puts a cross into the box and finds Ivan Romero (Levante), who latches on to it and strikes the ball inside the left post. He makes it 1:0.
36' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
35' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
35' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) works the corner short.
34' Ivan Romero (Levante) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
34' The ball possession at the moment is 55:45.
32' Ugo Raghouber (Levante) makes a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Kike Salas (Sevilla) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
31' The game is interrupted now, Kike Salas (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
28' Akor Adams (Sevilla) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
27' The corner by Oso (Sevilla) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
27' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
26' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Levante hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
23' Oriol Rey (Levante) gets a yellow card, off the field.

22' Carlos Espi (Levante) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Odysseas Vlachodimos has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
21' The resulting set piece from Levante is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
19' A rebound falls kindly for Oso (Sevilla), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
18' Akor Adams (Sevilla) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
17' The Sevilla players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
15' Sevilla players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
13' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
12' Nice passing game by Sevilla. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
10' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Akor Adams (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
9' Kareem Tunde (Levante) is penalised for a foul. Jose Sanchez had a clear view and blows his whistle.
8' Carlos Espi (Levante) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
6' The Sevilla players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Jose Sanchez. NO PENALTY!
4' Celebrations by Levante are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
4' It looks like Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) saw red with that tackle. Jose Sanchez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. PENALTY AWARDED to Levante!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Sevilla will kick the game off.
Jose Sanchez was nominated as the referee for this game.
